name: SouthWest Internet Systems
summary: Mandurah WA regional ISP ('SWIS', southwest.com.au); acquired/absorbed by EFTel ~2002. DISTINCT from SWISP (Bunbury).

events.details: Established in Mandurah WA by Paul Rolfe and Jurgen Steinert.
Acquired by EFTEL — absorbed by EFTel.

refs.label: By 30 Aug 2004 southwest.com.au redirected to EFTel; earlier 2004 captures still served SWIS content.
Domain later resolved to EFTel (Vocus/Dodo) branding.
